title: introduce-cost-knockout-autogen-tool
author: Ariana Chen
release_notes: Adds a lightweight analysis + autogen tool that identifies tenant-level cost drivers and emits compact batching and quantization presets; safe defaults are included and rollout guarded.
description:
Motivation: tenants frequently ask for assistance tuning batch/cache defaults and quant profiles. Existing workflows are manual and produce heavyweight presets. This PR introduces 'cost-knockout', a small CLI + runtime probe that runs controlled micro-synth workloads against live telemetry snapshots to isolate token-level cost contributors and synthesizes compact batch/quant presets that are safe to roll out.

What this PR does: implements a cost-knockout CLI (python), a runtime probe harness (go) that can be invoked in 'shadow' mode against live traffic, a compact preset serializer (yaml/json), and an opinionated rollout helper that generates canary policies for the Console. The tool: 1) samples a tenant workload profile; 2) runs a set of micro-synth experiments (batch shapes, kv-prefill thresholds, quant tiers) in a bounded sandbox; 3) measures per-token latencies/costs and quality proxies; 4) emits prioritized presets and safe-fallbacks.

User-facing changes: a new CLI under tools/cost-knockout, docs in docs/ops/cost-knockout.md, and a demo workflow in examples/cost-knockout/demo.yaml. Admins can run the CLI locally (dry-run) or submit a proposal to the Console for automatic canary rollout.

Backward compatibility & safety: generated presets include automatic guardrails (max latency uplift, quality delta thresholds). All rollouts are produced as Console-friendly policy fragments; by default the system requires approval for nontrivial latency/quality tradeoffs.

Checklist: - [x] implement probe harness and experiment runner - [x] CLI and serializer - [x] docs and examples - [x] integration tests for the probe harness - [x] end-to-end smoke in staging using sample tenant snapshots

Related: ENG-4876 (tenant-autotune backlog), ENG-4982 (safety gates for autosuggested presets).

review_comments: Priya Nair: Can we ensure the default generated presets never increase P99 beyond 15%? If not, expose an approval gate.
Ariana Chen: The generator emits a 'max_latency_uplift' and the Console import will reject presets above the tenant's SLA by default. Added unit and integration checks for that behavior.
Diego Martinez: The probe runner touches runtime internals; please add a smoke test that runs the probe in 'sandbox' (no network) mode to avoid flaking in CI.
Ariana Chen: Added tests/integration/test_cost_knockout.py which runs against a synthetic snapshot in CI; also added a Makefile target to run the smoke locally.
Ethan Park: Suggest moving the YAML schema to pkg/presets/schema to centralize. Also flagging a minor linter issue in adapter.go.
Ariana Chen: Moved schema and fixed lint; CI green on rerun.
ci_summary: Initial run failed on lint (adapter.go) and flaky e2e; fixed lint and stabilized e2e by adding deterministic seed for synthetic snapshots. Final run: all checks passed.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash (merge commit omitted). Merged by Priya Nair on 2024-12-05. Post-merge: staging canary run triggered and completed; rollout helpers added to the Console's preset import flow.
notes_for_release: Add documentation link to Console UI -> Preset proposals; ops runbook includes safe rollout examples and rollback steps. Recommend marketing to surface as 'autotune starter' for large tenants.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: generated presets could regress latency for tail workloads. Mitigation: strict default uplift caps, required approval for >10% P99 uplift, and automatic rollback if production telemetry violates safety thresholds within 10 minutes of canary traffic.
how_to_test: 1) run tools/cost-knockout/cli.py --dry-run --snapshot=examples/sample-snapshot.json; 2) inspect generated presets under /tmp/cost-knockout-output; 3) import via Console UI to a staging tenant; 4) run the staging e2e shadow job (ci/workflows/staging-cost-knockout.yml).
